sources: https://book.wvstateparks.com/ (Kanawha State Forest Electric Campsites, supplier 11067553; Non-electric Campsites, supplier 7989144)

values.note: Non-electric sites $34.99 a night, electric $39.99-$44.99 (WV State Parks booking site, the same for Tuesday 2026-10-27, Saturday 2026-10-31 and Tuesday 2027-06-15).

fees.source: https://book.wvstateparks.com/Ecomm/Listings/SupplierTile/7816932/en-US?supplierId=11067553 and ?supplierId=7989144 (one night 2026-10-27, 2026-10-31, 2027-06-15; two nights 2026-10-30/11-01; 2 adults), read 2026-10-21

values.note: April to December, weather permitting (no dates published).

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/kanawha-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-kanawha-state-forest/ ('The campground is open from April to December, weather permitting.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/kanawha-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-kanawha-state-forest/ ('25 of 46 sites have electricity and water hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 25 of the 46 sites have electric and water; each has a fireplace and picnic table. 'RVs or trailers/truck units longer than 26 feet are not recommended.'
Two bathhouses and a coin-operated laundry.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/kanawha-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-kanawha-state-forest/ ('The campground has two bathhouses and coin-operated laundry.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online (WV State Parks booking site), by phone or at the campground office. Weekend (Friday and Saturday) reservations need both nights; one night Sunday through Thursday (a single Tuesday night was offered on the booking site for 2026-10-27 and 2027-06-15).

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/kanawha-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-kanawha-state-forest/ ('Campsites may be reserved online, by phone, or at the campground office', 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one night Sunday through Thursday', 'There is a 14-night maximum stay') + book.wvstateparks.com one-night Tuesday listings, read 2026-10-21

note: Campground along Davis Creek; access roads are narrow and curvy. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the state:WV row for this forest from its own camping page (reservable online/phone/office, 2-night Friday-Saturday minimum with single weeknights sold, 14-night max) and the booking site (single Tuesday nights offered). Confirmed fees ($34.99 non-electric, $39.99-44.99 electric), 46 sites, 26-ft limit, water at the hookup sites, April-December season. Added laundry and the two bathhouses (showers not stated). Not stated: electric amperage, sewer, dump station.
